2607.06364.title: Automated Compliance Mapping in Cloud Security with Domain-Adapted Sentence Transformers
2607.06364.paper_summary: Mapping cloud security controls to technical metrics is currently a manual process. This paper proposes domain adaptation of Sentence Transformer models to automate it. We build a training corpus of 3,499 semantic pairs from five European security standards and a set of technical metrics, then expand it via back-translation and LLM-based paraphrasing to up to 13,996 samples across four scenarios. We fine-tune five architectures and evaluate their performance on two independent tasks: control-to-metric and cross-standard controls association. All fine-tuned models outperform their zero-shot baselines. On the control-to-metric task, the best model gains up to 23 nDCG@10 points, while on the cross-standard control task, \textit{multi-qa-mpnet-dot-v1} under back-translation reaches 0.870 nDCG@10. The results show that in-domain training data is a primary driver of performance for the considered case studies.
2607.06364.paper_summary_zh: 將雲端安全控制映射到技術指標目前是一個手動過程。本文提出了對句子變換器模型的領域適應以自動化此過程。我們從五個歐洲安全標準和一組技術指標中建立了一個包含3,499個語義對的訓練語料庫，然後通過反向翻譯和基於LLM的改寫將其擴展到最多13,996個樣本，涵蓋四種場景。我們微調了五種架構，並在兩個獨立任務上評估它們的性能：控制到指標和跨標準控制關聯。所有微調的模型均超越了其零樣本基準。在控制到指標任務中，最佳模型獲得了高達23個nDCG@10點，而在跨標準控制任務中，\textit{multi-qa-mpnet-dot-v1}在反向翻譯下達到了0.870 nDCG@10。結果顯示，領域內訓練數據是考慮的案例研究性能的主要驅動因素。
